meta.title: Comprehensive Mental Disorder Diagnosis Ontology
sources: ICD-11 Chapter 06 (Mental, Behavioural or Neurodevelopmental Disorders)
DSM-5-TR (Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders, 5th Edition, Text Revision, 2022)
meta.description: Complete hierarchical classification of mental disorders from ICD-11 and DSM-5-TR, including diagnostic codes, subtypes, common comorbidities, age of onset, gender ratios, and relevant scales.

schema.name: Mental, Behavioural or Neurodevelopmental Disorders
schema.name_zh: 精神、行为或神经发育障碍
schema.description: Syndromes characterised by clinically significant disturbance in cognition, emotional regulation, or behaviour reflecting dysfunction in psychological, biological, or developmental processes underlying mental and behavioural functioning.
schema.description_zh: 以个体认知、情绪调节或行为的临床显著紊乱为特征，反映心理、生物或发育过程功能障碍的综合征。

icd11.name: ICD-11 Chapter 06 — Mental, Behavioural or Neurodevelopmental Disorders

blocks.name: Neurodevelopmental disorders
blocks.description: Behavioural and cognitive disorders arising during developmental period involving significant difficulties in acquisition and execution of intellectual, motor, or social functions.

blocks.name: Schizophrenia or other primary psychotic disorders
blocks.name_zh: 精神分裂症或其他原发性精神病性障碍
blocks.description: Characterized by disturbances in thinking, perception, emotions, and behaviour, with reality testing impairment and delusions/hallucinations.

subtypes.description: subtyped: currently symptomatic / partial remission / full remission

blocks.name: Catatonia
blocks.description: Psychomotor syndrome characterized by marked disturbances in activity, posture, speech, and responsiveness.

blocks.name: Mood disorders
blocks.description: Disorders characterized by disturbances in mood or affect, either depressive (sadness/hopelessness) or manic (elation/irritability).
blocks.description_zh: 以情绪或情感的紊乱为特征的障碍，抑郁（悲伤/无望）或躁狂（兴奋/易怒）。

subtypes.name: Current severe depression with psychotic

blocks.name: Anxiety or fear-related disorders
blocks.name_zh: 焦虑或恐惧相关性障碍
blocks.description: Disorders characterized by excessive fear, anxiety, and avoidance behaviours.
blocks.description_zh: 以过度的恐惧、焦虑和回避行为为特征的障碍。

disorders.name: Generalized anxiety disorder
disorders.description: Excessive anxiety and worry about multiple events/activities, most days for at least several months.
disorders.description_zh: 对多种事件或活动的过度焦虑和担忧，持续至少数月。

disorders.name: Panic disorder
disorders.description: Recurrent unexpected panic attacks with fear of future attacks.
disorders.description_zh: 反复的意外惊恐发作，伴对未来发作的恐惧。

disorders.name: Agoraphobia
disorders.description: Fear of situations where escape might be difficult or help unavailable.
disorders.description_zh: 对难以逃离或无法获得帮助的场合的恐惧。

disorders.name: Specific phobia
disorders.description: Intense fear of a specific object or situation (e.g., animals, heights, blood).
disorders.description_zh: 对特定物体或情境（如动物、高处、血液）的强烈恐惧。

disorders.name: Social anxiety disorder
disorders.description: Marked fear of social situations involving potential scrutiny by others.
disorders.description_zh: 对可能被他人审视的社交场合的显著恐惧。

disorders.name: Separation anxiety disorder
disorders.description: Developmentally inappropriate fear of separation from attachment figures.
disorders.description_zh: 与依恋对象分离时出现与发育水平不相称的恐惧。

disorders.name: Selective mutism
disorders.description: Consistent failure to speak in specific social situations despite speaking in others.
disorders.description_zh: 在特定社交场合持续不说话，尽管在其他场合能说话。

disorders.name: Other specified anxiety or fear-related disorders
disorders.name_zh: 其他特指的焦虑或恐惧相关性障碍

disorders.name: Anxiety or fear-related disorders, unspecified
disorders.name_zh: 焦虑或恐惧相关性障碍,未特指的

subtypes.name_zh: 伴较差自知力或缺乏自知力

subtypes.name_zh: 伴较差自知力或缺乏自知力

disorders.name_zh: 聚焦于躯体的重复行为障碍

disorders.name_zh: 其他特指的强迫性或相关障碍

disorders.name: OCRD, unspecified
disorders.name_zh: 强迫性或相关障碍,未特指的

disorders.name: Post-traumatic stress disorder
disorders.description: Develops following exposure to an extremely threatening or horrific event; characterized by re-experiencing, avoidance, hyperarousal.
disorders.description_zh: 在经历极端威胁或恐怖事件后发展；以再体验、回避、过度警觉为特征。

disorders.name: Complex post-traumatic stress disorder
disorders.name_zh: 复杂性创伤后应激障碍
disorders.description: Develops after sustained/repeated trauma; includes PTSD symptoms + disturbances in self-organization (affect dysregulation, negative self-concept, interpersonal difficulties).
disorders.description_zh: 在持续/重复的创伤后发展；除PTSD症状外，还有自我组织障碍（情感调节障碍、消极自我概念、人际关系困难）。

disorders.name: Prolonged grief disorder
disorders.description: Persistent and pervasive grief response lasting >6 months after bereavement.
disorders.description_zh: 在丧亲后持续>6个月的弥漫性哀伤反应。

disorders.name: Adjustment disorder
disorders.description: Emotional/behavioural symptoms in response to an identifiable psychosocial stressor.
disorders.description_zh: 对可识别的心理社会应激源的适应性情绪/行为反应。

disorders.name: Reactive attachment disorder
disorders.description: Severely disturbed attachment behaviour in young children due to social neglect.
disorders.description_zh: 因社会忽视导致的幼儿严重依恋行为紊乱。

disorders.name: Disinhibited social engagement disorder
disorders.name_zh: 脱抑制性社会参与障碍
disorders.description: Indiscriminate social approach in young children due to social neglect.
disorders.description_zh: 因社会忽视导致的幼儿不加区别的社交行为。

disorders.name: Dissociative identity disorder

disorders.name: Personality disorder
disorders.description: A marked disturbance in personality functioning, manifested in impairments in self-functioning (identity, self-worth, self-direction) and/or interpersonal functioning.
disorders.description_zh: 人格功能的显著紊乱，表现在自我功能（身份、自我价值、自我导向）和/或人际功能方面的损害。

disorders.name: Prominent personality traits or patterns
disorders.description: Trait domain specifiers that describe the characteristics of personality functioning. The borderline pattern corresponds closely to DSM-5 borderline PD.
disorders.description_zh: 描述人格功能特征的特质领域限定词。边缘型模式与DSM-5边缘型人格障碍高度对应。
